Class AsyncUpdateBuilder<T>

java.lang.Object
dev.hogwai.dynamodb.simplified.builder.base.AbstractUpdateBuilder<T, AsyncUpdateBuilder<T>>
dev.hogwai.dynamodb.simplified.async.AsyncUpdateBuilder<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the type of the item
public class AsyncUpdateBuilder<T> extends AbstractUpdateBuilder<T, AsyncUpdateBuilder<T>>
Async fluent builder for updating an item in a DynamoDB table. Supports both full-item replacement and partial updates via an UpdateExpression. Part of the DynamoDB Simplified library.

    • execute

      public @NonNull CompletableFuture<Optional<T>> execute()
      Executes the update operation. If a partial update expression was configured via AbstractUpdateBuilder.update(java.util.function.Consumer), a targeted partial update is performed via the low-level async DynamoDB client. Otherwise, the full item is replaced.
      Returns:
      a CompletableFuture containing the updated item, or empty if not found
